root.label: Forbes fires Randall Lane after undisclosed payment

events.label: Forbes fires Randall Lane after undisclosed payment

slots.name: payment amount
slots.sentence: Lane was fired after the company learned that he had accepted a payment of about $6 million from the founder of a company that does business with the magazine, Ben Mullin reports for The Times:

slots.name: resignation date
slots.sentence: When Randall Lane abruptly resigned last month after 15 years as the top editor of Forbes, he said that it was “time to live the spirit of the brand and try something new.”

slots.name: payment date
slots.sentence: The payment was made after Mr. Shook sold a majority stake in Shook Research to PPC Enterprises, a private equity firm, last August, two of the people familiar with the transaction said.

slots.name: disclosure status
slots.sentence: Lane violated company policy by not disclosing the gift, a decision he told The Times that he regretted.
